actions.description: Type or change the value in the Name text input field
Move focus away from the Name input, triggering onBlur validation
Type or change the value in the Description textarea field
Move focus away from the Description textarea, triggering onBlur validation
Type or change the value in the SKU text input field
Move focus away from the SKU input, triggering onBlur validation
Type into the Category combobox input to filter or create categories
Select an existing category from the Category combobox dropdown
Select the '+ Create' option to use a typed-in value as a new category
Clear the selected category value so it becomes null
Select an existing unit definition from the Unit dropdown (create mode only)
Select the '+ Create new unit' option from the Unit dropdown, which opens the Create Unit dialog
Type or change the value in the Purchase Price input field
Move focus away from the Purchase Price input, triggering onBlur validation
Type or change the value in the Selling Price input field
Move focus away from the Selling Price input, triggering onBlur validation
Type or change the value in the Stock input field
Move focus away from the Stock input, triggering onBlur validation
Type or change the value in the Safety Stock input field
Move focus away from the Safety Stock input, triggering onBlur validation
Click the Cancel button to navigate back without saving
Click the Create/Save Changes button to submit the form
Open the Create Unit dialog
Close the Create Unit dialog by clicking the overlay or pressing Escape, which also resets unit form fields
Type or change the value in the unit Name input inside the Create Unit dialog
Type or change the value in the unit Size input inside the Create Unit dialog
Select a unit of measure from the UOM dropdown inside the Create Unit dialog
Click the Cancel button inside the Create Unit dialog to close it without creating a unit
Click the Create button inside the Create Unit dialog to submit the new unit definition
Switch BOM mode from 'Quantity per unit' to 'Percentage'
Switch BOM mode from 'Percentage' to 'Quantity per unit'
Click the '+ Add Ingredient' button to append a new empty BOM row
Type into a BOM row's component combobox input to filter available components
Select a component from the BOM row's combobox dropdown
Type or change the quantity value in a BOM row's input (when bomMode is 'quantity')
Type or change the percentage value in a BOM row's input (when bomMode is 'percentage')
Click the X button on a BOM row to remove that ingredient
